description: This file declares the class dm_neighbor_list_t, which extends dm_neighbor_t and db_easy_mesh_t, and provides methods for managing a list of neighbors, including database synchronization, configuration, and navigation functions. It also contains virtual functions for neighbor access and manipulation.

classes.name: dm_neighbor_list_t
classes.description: A class for managing a list of neighbors, with database integration and virtual methods for neighbor access.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Retrieves the orchestrator type for a given neighbor.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the internal neighbor list based on operation.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes or clears the neighbor list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the in-memory neighbor list with the database.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Updates the neighbor information in the database.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches for a neighbor in the database using a key.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for dm_easy_mesh_t objects.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters from JSON or neighbor object.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration into a JSON object.

methods.name: get_first_neighbor
methods.description: Virtual method to get the first neighbor.

methods.name: get_next_neighbor
methods.description: Virtual method to get the next neighbor after the given one.

methods.name: get_neighbor
methods.description: Virtual method to get a neighbor by key.

methods.name: remove_neighbor
methods.description: Virtual method to remove a neighbor by key.

methods.name: put_neighbor
methods.description: Virtual method to add or update a neighbor with key.
